name: Website Development
heroSubtitle: Professional websites designed to strengthen your online presence, showcase your brand and help your business grow.
shortDescription: We design and develop modern, responsive websites that help businesses and individuals establish a professional online presence.
fullDescription: TOP TECH creates professional websites tailored to the needs of individuals, businesses and organisations. Whether you need a company website, personal portfolio, landing page or a custom digital platform, we focus on clean design, responsive layouts, intuitive navigation and a strong user experience. We work with you to understand your goals and build a website that communicates your brand effectively and gives your audience a clear way to connect with you.

faqs.question: What types of websites do you develop?
faqs.answer: We develop business websites, personal portfolios, landing pages, organisational websites and other custom website solutions based on project requirements.

faqs.question: Will my website work on mobile phones?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build responsive websites designed to adapt to smartphones, tablets and desktop screens.

faqs.question: Can I update my website after it is completed?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can provide suitable content-management options or guidance for updating your website, depending on the technology used.

faqs.question: Will my website appear on Google?
faqs.answer: We can configure basic SEO elements to help search engines understand your website. Search visibility and ranking depend on several factors and cannot be guaranteed.

faqs.question: How long does website development take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the number of pages, design requirements, content and requested features. We will agree on a suitable timeline after discussing your project.

idealFor: Businesses, entrepreneurs, startups, professionals, personal brands, institutions and organisations looking to establish or improve their online presence.
